Name: JP's No Time Stop - Real Time
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][i][u]No Time Stop[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Out of nowhere, a huge window opened right above me, and I couldn't move and was scared.[/size][/color][/i][/font][/b]


[size=4][font=Georgia][b]This mod prevents time from stopping when you perform certain actions and allows NPCs to continue moving.[/b]

[color=#00ffff][b]What the mod does:[/b][/color]
[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia][i]It allows time to pass while you open the game menus.[/i][/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia][i]It allows you to move while navigating certain menus, such as the inventory.[/i][/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia][i]It allows time to pass during dialogues, mini-games, fishing, or events.[/i][/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3JF0DgqY/time1.gif[/img][/font][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/y86ghDqY/time1-1.gif[/img][/font][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/m2y1FQnt/time1-2.gif[/img][/font][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/WbwqJMy1/time1-3.gif[/img][/font][/b][/size]


[size=4][b][font=Georgia]That's all. I hope it doesn't break anything. Remember to use GMCM for a simpler and faster mod setup. [/font][/b][/size]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.[/size]
[size=4]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color][/size]
[size=4]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
